annotations.title: Get a home health or hospice inspection

description: The tool gets one home health or hospice inspection by type (home_health or hospice), the six-character CCN and, optionally, the survey event ID or date. It gets the latest inspection when you omit the event. It returns each finding with its tag and level and the inspector's statement from Form CMS-2567 as CMS publishes it. Each call returns five findings with an offset. Dialysis inspections are not held yet.

ccn.description: The facility's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN).

event.description: The survey event ID or the survey date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit it for the latest inspection.

offset.description: How many items to skip for the next page of a long list.
